South Side Cycling Club Wednesday Evening Ride

St. Louis, MO · Bevo Mill · Road

Beginner friendly

South Side Cycling Club Wednesday Evening Ride is a road group ride in St. Louis, MO. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from South Side Cyclery. About 10–30 miles, beginner (up to 10 mi in 1:45), party pace 12–13 mph, intermediate 14–15 mph, advanced 16+ mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @southsidecyclery the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the South Side Cycling Club Wednesday Evening Ride group ride

Four pace groups leave the shop at once, from a true beginner group up to 16+ mph. Routes change weekly around the city and county. Helmets and lights required; arrive early to sign the waiver. Ride changes post on the club's Facebook and Instagram. The shop also runs a fall Saturday 8 am training ride.
